mapper.select: select m.doccode as docCode, m.docdate as docDate, m.doctype as docType, m.sourcedoctype as sourceDocType, m.sourcedoccode as sourceDocCode, d.goodscode as goodsCode, d.goodsname as goodsName, d.qty as qty, d.costamount as costAmount, d.saleamount as saleAmount from sdsorder.u_f_docmain_${suffix} m join sdsorder.u_f_docdetail_${suffix} d on d.shop_code = m.shop_code and d.doccode = m.doccode where m.shop_code = #{shopCode} and m.confirmstate = '已审核' and ((m.doctype = 'CK' and m.sourcedoctype in ('XSFH', 'XSBF')) or (m.doctype = 'XSTHRK' and m.sourcedoctype = 'SO')) and m.docdate >= #{begin} and m.docdate < #{endExclusive} order by m.docdate, m.doccode, d.lineno
